items.title: Anthropic’s Dario Amodei gets the SNL treatment
items.summary: "AI is the devil and I its maker."

items.title: TechCrunch Mobility: AV companies pick their lanes
items.summary: Welcome back to TechCrunch Mobility, your hub for the future of transportation and now, more than ever, the role AI is playing in it.

items.title: Sennheiser Momentum 5 review: Great sound, incredible battery life, and few compromises
items.summary: I spent the last few weeks with the Sennheiser Momentum 5 to determine if this pair actually stands out, testing everything from sound quality and noise cancellation to comfort and battery life.

items.title: PNOE’s new face mask wants to make lab-grade breath testing a self-serve affair
items.summary: PNOĒ, the Malden, Mass.-based startup whose breath-analyzing mask used to bear an unfortunate resemblance to Bane's, is launching a sleeker self-serve version on October 1 that lets gym-goers measure their VO₂ max and other metabolic markers in eight minutes without a trained operator.

items.title: Google tests buying from Walmart-owned Flipkart through Gemini and AI Mode in India
items.summary: The limited test covers select products and users, with a broader rollout planned for later in October.

items.title: Insurers claim AI is already increasing healthcare costs
items.summary: Blue Cross Blue Shield says hospital use of AI tools led to an additional $942M in healthcare spending over a two-year period.

items.title: TikTok agrees to pay at least $100M in Alabama settlement
items.summary: TikTok will pay Alabama at least $100 million in a settlement tied to allegations that the short-form video platform misled users about safety and was designed to addict children.

items.title: Meta and YouTube say they will run ads for ‘Musk’ documentary after all
items.summary: Two companies now say they will accept advertising for director Alex Gibney’s upcoming documentary about Elon Musk, following earlier reporting that a number of social media platforms had rejected the ads.

items.title: Levoit’s new air purifier is for the pet odors that have taken over your apartment
items.summary: This $189.99 air purifier is specifically designed to tackle pet odors, removing up to 70% in one hour.

items.title: I created an interactive digital avatar of myself — and you can talk to it
items.summary: After obtaining an interactive avatar and training it to discuss venture fraud, I have mixed feelings about making AI clones of ourselves.

items.title: At Meta Connect, the company’s smart glasses were everywhere
items.summary: The company behind Facebook and Instagram wants to keep consumers connected to the digital world via its ever-growing line of smart glasses.

items.title: Crusoe abandons $1.25B plan to use Boom turbines at AI data centers
items.summary: Boom Supersonic CEO Blake Scholl said the company's new stationary power plants were no longer in Crusoe's near-term plans.

items.title: Automattic has a new board after failed attempt to put CEO on leave
items.summary: After days of upheaval at Automattic, following a failed attempt to remove CEO Matt Mullenweg, the company has a new board.

items.title: Unsecured OpenAI agents posted 53 user images on the internet without the lab’s knowledge
items.summary: AI agents operating in OpenAI's research environment posted user images on public image-hosting sites without the lab's knowledge.

items.title: Meta opens early access program for new Muse features
items.summary: Anyone interested in joining has to ask Muse to put them on the list.

items.title: The hottest new hangout for middle schoolers is NPR’s comment section?
items.summary: When NPR staffers flagged strange comments under their podcasts on Spotify as bots, it took a Gen Z colleague to (immediately) figure out the mystery.

items.title: Anthropic to pay Akamai $11.6 billion over seven years in cloud deal
items.summary: Anthropic has committed $11.6 billion over seven years to Akamai's cloud infrastructure, a bet on CPUs that could grow to about $20 billion, and in an unusual arrangement, Akamai is giving Anthropic a potential stake of up to 5% of its stock that grows as Anthropic spends more.

items.title: Mark Wahlberg is coming to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, and he wants to talk about your work, not his
items.summary: Mark Wahlberg joins Bruce K. Lee at Disrupt to discuss investing, entrepreneurship, healthcare, wellness, and building businesses.

items.title: Ahead of US IPO, British AI neocloud Nscale secures $3.36B in convertible financing
items.summary: The funding, which comes from Third Point, Nvidia, and others, will fuel the company's massive AI data center buildout.

items.title: The Aeropod automates soil aeration without robotics — see it at TechCrunch Disrupt
items.summary: Muju Earth Technologies has developed a deceptively simply pod that can save farmers money while improving crop yields.
